editorial:
Imagine you are working your tail off at a big firm, doing everything right to get that big promotion. That is exactly where you find yourself with Daniel Stern, who plays a stockbroker just trying to climb the corporate ladder. The problem is that his boss has a stunning, flirty wife who is determined to make his professional life a total mess. It is a classic setup that feels like a wild party from the eighties, focusing on the awkward and spicy tension between a man who wants a career and a woman who just wants to have some fun. The whole vibe is light, cheeky, and doesn't take itself too seriously, making it a great pick for a lazy weekend.

What really makes this work is Daniel Stern's comedic timing, as he plays the stressed-out guy perfectly. While the plot is pretty simple and predictable, the chemistry between the leads keeps you interested. Some parts might feel a bit dated, but that just adds to the charm of this era of bedroom comedies. If you love old-school rom-coms with a bit of an edge, you should definitely give this one a shot.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the boss finally finds out about the flirtatious games his wife has been playing. Instead of a huge corporate disaster, the movie wraps up with a funny twist where the boss realizes he is not as in control as he thought. The main character manages to keep his job and finds a way to balance his ambition with his love life, leaving everyone happy and laughing in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic 80s adult comedies and romantic mishaps.
